mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact kinetic pressure-energy identity and finite numerical checks of relativistic partition, level moments, broad-level mixture normalization, NR/UR tails, and conditional near-match control.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Positive real variables; exact SymPy algebra and IEEE double-precision quadrature
mathematics.conventions: Homogeneous dilute number-phase distribution; canonical d^3p measure; kinetic energy sqrt(m^2 c^4+p^2 c^2)-mc^2. Numerics use m=c=1. A_mix=C/beta is not presumed a spatial EOS coefficient.
non_claims: No universal EOS or self-gravitating equilibrium
No physical selection of phase span
No normalization selection from finite numerical sampling
